title: 2012 Leaf Draft Red #36 Mohamed Sanu Rutgers Scarlet Knights Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2012 Leaf Draft sports trading card features Mohamed Sanu, a Rutgers Scarlet Knights football player. The card is a red parallel/variety in the base set, and is considered a rookie card for Sanu's debut season. The card number is 36 and it is produced by Leaf manufacturer. It's a great addition to any collection for fans of the sport or collectors of trading cards.
